orgDesign.companyProfile: Mid-size EU-centric horizontal classifieds marketplace with broad category coverage, high casual-seller volume, a meaningful professional-merchant business, an ecosystem of integration partners, and shared trust, payments, data, and platform services.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Stream-aligned teams own buyer, seller, merchant, and partner value streams; a consolidated set of durable platform families (Identity & Trust, Payments & Transactions, Experience Platform, Marketplace Data & Intelligence, Developer Platform) and a dedicated Partner Platform provide reusable identity, payment, data, experience, and integration foundations. Platform teams are accountable through explicit consuming-team contracts.

teamTypes.name: Stream-aligned
teamTypes.description: Aligned to a product, service, or customer journey; owns end-to-end delivery and outcomes.

teamTypes.name: Platform
teamTypes.description: Provides reusable capabilities, services, or infrastructure to multiple stream-aligned teams.

teamTypes.name: Enabling
teamTypes.description: Helps stream-aligned teams overcome obstacles, adopt technologies, or improve practices.

teamTypes.name: Complicated subsystem
teamTypes.description: Owns a complex subsystem that requires specialized knowledge and skills.

teamTypes.name: Other
teamTypes.description: Does not fit the other categories (e.g. a temporary or cross-functional team).

teamDependencyTypes.name: Collaboration
teamDependencyTypes.description: Working closely together with another team.

teamDependencyTypes.name: X-as-a-Service
teamDependencyTypes.description: Consuming or providing something with minimal collaboration.

teamDependencyTypes.name: Facilitating
teamDependencyTypes.description: Helping (or being helped by) another team to clear impediments.

teamDependencyTypes.name: Other
teamDependencyTypes.description: Any other type of dependency not covered above.
